cohort: Healthy, full-term neonates born by normal vaginal route or cesarean section in a rural tertiary hospital with uneventful perinatal periods
finding: Babies delivered by cesarean section showed significantly higher weight loss in the first week of life, and lower weight gain at the end of first month than babies born by vaginal route.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by cesarean section showed a higher weight loss (% of birth weight) at 24 hours and 72 hours of life, and lower weight gain at 28 days of life.
